item.description: JOURNAL SPORTS Haughton’s eight-run fourth inning Friday night in a District 1-5A game set the stage for quite a postgame celebration of an early March win. item.title: Shreveport Police Department opens North Police Substation
item.description: Community leaders and law enforcement officials gathered on March 5 for the grand opening of the Shreveport Police Department’s new North Police Substation. The facility, located at 1407 N. Market Street, is intended to enhance public safety and increase law enforcement presence in North Shreveport. item.title: Local firefighter graduates from Arkansas State Fire Academy
item.description: Members of Bossier Parish Fire District No. 1 recently attended a graduation ceremony to support one of their volunteer firefighters as he completed training at the Arkansas State Fire Academy in Camden, Arkansas. Firefighter Josh Goode graduated from the academy as part of his training for his full-time position with South Bossier Fire District 2. item.description: A Caddo Parish jury deliberated nearly two hours on March 4 before convicting a Shreveport man of home invasion and cruelty to an infirm person in connection with the assault and robbery of a 91-year-old woman last summer.
